tool_input.description: 确认Nacos服务清单响应字段
tool_input.command:
$login = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri '{{ov_privacy:default:viking://~/privacy/credential/nacos-taicang-dev#/values/base_url}}v1/auth/login' -Method Post -ContentType 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded' -Body 'username=nacos&password={{ov_privacy:default:viking://~/privacy/credential/nacos-taicang-dev#/values/password}}' -SkipHttpErrorCheck -TimeoutSec 15
$token = [string](($login.Content | ConvertFrom-Json -ErrorAction Stop).accessToken)
$uri = '{{ov_privacy:default:viking://~/privacy/credential/nacos-taicang-dev#/values/base_url}}v1/ns/service/list?pageNo=1&pageSize=1000&groupName=DEFAULT_GROUP&namespaceId=suzhou-taicang-wuguan&accessToken=' + [uri]::EscapeDataString($token)
$data = (Invoke-WebRequest -Uri $uri -Method Get -SkipHttpErrorCheck -TimeoutSec 15).Content | ConvertFrom-Json -ErrorAction Stop
'RESPONSE_KEYS=' + ($data.PSObject.Properties.Name -join ',')
foreach ($property in $data.PSObject.Properties) { if ($null -ne $property.Value -and $property.Value -is [array]) { 'ARRAY_FIELD=' + $property.Name + ';COUNT=' + $property.Value.Count; 'TARGET_NAMES=' + ((@($property.Value | Where-Object { ([string]$_) -match '(?i)zhishu-(gateway|auth|system|file|company)' })) -join ',') } }
